4,800 compliance checks, one dot per 6

A checkmark has no interior, only a line and a thickness, so the dots pack a stroked centreline rather than an outline. That is a different region behind the same packer: the shape is three points and a width, instead of both sides of both arms with a mitred corner drawn by hand.

1 dot = 6 checks
